objective: Require source-backed semantic eligibility for corpus results and preserve every item tied at a requested ranking cutoff.

evidence: debugger/C10/summary.json: issue-coverage-gap recurred in 19 tasks and incomplete-document-reading recurred in 12 tasks
debugger/C10/tasks/task-b344e8fa8eaab912cf3b/result.json: strong evidence of relevance substituted for the requested direct or responsive relationship
debugger/C10/tasks/task-9735028cf53a2980ffb9/result.json: a late exclusion-to-inclusion reversal contradicted the source-backed semantic gate
debugger/C10/tasks/task-217c3258a03b095322ef/result.json: exact-cardinality guidance deterministically truncated an equal cutoff tie
changes.failure_pattern: Corpus runs often found and read relevant evidence but then admitted candidates that failed the requested category relationship, reversed dispositions without rechecking every gate, or forced a top-N tie into exactly N rows.
changes.mechanism: Classify candidate relationships as direct, responsive, peripheral, or uncertain; require an exact read source and pass/fail/uncertain state for every eligibility gate; adversarially recheck late reversals; and treat N as rank depth with every co-ranked cutoff item presented unless the user supplies a tie-break.
changes.rationale: The earliest shared failure occurs in semantic gate formulation and application after discovery, so the registered corpus procedure is the reusable surface that controls candidate classification without hard-coding legal categories.

evidence: attribution/C9/transition.json: chg-3 was MIXED because artifact and count checks could still accept a semantically wrong self-audit
debugger/C10/tasks/task-9735028cf53a2980ffb9/result.json: final audit certified internal counts after an unsupported late inclusion
debugger/C10/tasks/task-217c3258a03b095322ef/result.json: finish audit reinforced a fabricated tie-break and incomplete principal result set
changes.failure_pattern: The C9 finish interlock verified artifacts, zero counts, and self-reported cardinality but did not require per-gate semantic support or distinguish rank depth from row count at a cutoff tie.
changes.mechanism: Extend the structured completion audit with required semantic-gate and cutoff-tie states; reject corpus completion unless every inclusion has source-backed passes and reject unresolved ranking ties, while preserving capped rejections and existing artifact checks.
changes.rationale: C9's deterministic finish gate is the strongest existing completion control; improving its audit contract addresses the mixed result more reliably than another prompt reminder while leaving substantive eligibility decisions with the agent and sources.
